name: Trimax Corporation
summary: Trimax Corporation offers a broad spectrum of digital solutions, specializing in the development of both mobile and web applications. Their service offerings further encompass technology consulting, cloud computing, and expertise in areas such as e-commerce, business intelligence, and data analytics. Beyond its core technology offerings, Trimax Corporation maintains a diverse portfolio of interests. These include agricultural ventures, specifically organic olive farming and coffee supply, alongside involvement in real estate development and the tourism sector. A distinct division of the company is dedicated to the marine industry, overseeing the design, manufacturing, sales, international export, and comprehensive after-sales service for yachts and their components. The company's headquarters are situated in Ft Lauderdale, Florida.
